hints.title: Matching Tags Hierarchy
hints.text: A valid code block is enclosed by a matching start and end tag, with correctly nested inner tags and character data blocks.

hints.title: Tag Validation Grammar Rules
hints.text: Tag names must contain between 1 and 9 uppercase letters. character data contents must be enclosed strictly within open and close tags.

hints.title: Parsing Stack Automation
hints.text: Scan through characters with an index. If parsing character data, verify prefix and find closing marker. If parsing closing tag, match against tag stack top. If parsing opening tag, push to stack. If stack becomes empty before reaching end of string, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Deterministic parser scanning code with stack depth bounded by N.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions without state memory cannot validate arbitrarily nested matching tags.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack storage tracks open tag context in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle CDATA, uppercase tag constraints, and empty-stack termination.
